description: This PHP source file defines the `MembershipAPI` class, which implements CRUD (Create, Read, Update, Delete) operations for managing memberships in the OrangeHRM human resource management system. It includes API endpoint definitions, validation rules, and interaction with the MembershipService to perform data operations. The file also contains OpenAPI (Swagger) annotations for automatic API documentation.

classes.name: MembershipAPI
classes.description: Defines API endpoints for managing Membership entities including retrieval, creation, updating, and deletion, with validations and Swagger documentation integration.

methods.name: getMembershipService
methods.description: Lazy loads and returns the instance of MembershipService used to perform business logic related to memberships.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Handles GET request to retrieve a specific membership by ID, returning a serialized MembershipModel.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for retrieving a single membership, primarily validating the ID parameter.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles GET request to list all memberships with support for pagination and sorting.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for listing memberships, focusing on sorting and pagination parameters.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles POST request to create a new membership entity.

methods.name: saveMembership
methods.description: Sets the member's name from request parameters and saves the membership via the service layer.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for creating a new membership, primarily validating the name parameter.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles PUT request to update an existing membership identified by ID.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for updating a membership, including name validation and respect for unique constraints.

methods.name: getNameRule
methods.description: Creates and returns a validation rule for the 'name' parameter, ensuring it is a string, within length limits, and unique.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE request to remove multiple memberships by IDs.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the delete operation, validating an array of numeric IDs.
